title: Ada and the Border
author: M. M. Delacroix
blurb: Tamsin Joubert, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
